changed.name: High Peak Homeless Help emergency accommodation

before.referral: Emergency accommodation (hosts or B&B): call the referral number 07973 670595.

after.referral: Referrals from agencies (e.g. Citizens Advice, schools, churches, local voluntary groups) by phone on 07973 670595; the referrer must be with the person for a short risk assessment. Self-referrals only in exceptional circumstances.

before.referral: Referral through Blackpool Council Housing Options: 01253 477760 (Mon-Fri).

after.referral: Referral via Blackpool's Housing Options team (a referral MUST be submitted by them): 01253 477760, housing.options@blackpool.gov.uk.

before.referral: Young people 16-21. Referral via a Liverpool MainStay assessment.

after.referral: Contact your local Housing Options team (Liverpool: 0151 233 3061) – they’ll assess your situation and help you access support, including referrals to services like Homeground. You can also complete a Mainstay assessment, which is the referral route for supported accommodation across the Liverpool City Region. You cannot refer yourself directly to Homeground – all referrals must come through Housing Options or Social Services.

before.referral: Call 01223 576085 to ask how to get a place.

after.referral: Call 01223 576085 or email info@jimmyscambridge.org.uk. Referrals also accepted from local partner organisations; if sleeping rough, contact the Street Outreach Team on 01223 366 292 (weekdays 08:00–16:00). For immediate support, come to 1 East Road.

before.referral: Drug and alcohol-free supported hostel. Call 01202 393178 to ask about a referral.

after.referral: Referrals accepted from statutory and voluntary agencies, community and church groups. Rough sleepers can book an admission assessment with the staff team directly by phoning 01202 393178 or emailing info@michaelhouse.co.uk.

before.referral: All referrals come from Streetwork: 0808 178 2323. Couples and individuals.

after.referral: All referrals come from Streetwork: 18 South Bridge, Edinburgh, EH1 1LL, 0808 178 2323.
